name: @platform/agent
description: The conversational agent as a library a backend mounts: one host interface, the AG-UI route it is served over, and its implementation on Foundry Agent Service — prompt-agent versions by content hash, the backend's own tool loop with the browser's controls, the thread index and ownership on Cosmos DB, the memory store (preview) or a store of the deployment's own by one setting, skills (preview), the service's web search, the erase path, the operator's tool gating, idempotent turns and the three-part prompt.
